notes_list.title: Striling Pratyay (Feminine Endings)
notes_list.basic_overview: Bhavvachak sangya jinke ant mein -ता, -वट, -हट, -आस, -आई aata hai, wo mostly striling hoti hain.
notes_list.extra_info_content: -ता: सुंदरता, मित्रता; -वट/-हट: सजावट, घबराहट; -आस: मिठास, प्यास; -आई: पढ़ाई, लिखाई.

notes_list.title: Pullinga Pratyay (Masculine Endings)
notes_list.basic_overview: Bhavvachak sangya jinke ant mein -पा, -पन, -आव, -त्व aata hai, wo mostly pullinga hoti hain.
notes_list.extra_info_content: -पा/-पन: बुढ़ापा, बचपन, लड़कपन; -आव: बहाव, चुनाव; -त्व: मनुष्यत्व, कवित्व. 'Mostly' ka matlab hai ki apwad bhi ho sakte hain.
